name: Pays d'Auge colombage house
description: Two-storey Pays d'Auge house, 12.8 x 8.6 m: a rubble-stone sill wall under rendered timbering on the ground floor, close-studded oak timbering with herringbone brick nogging on the jettied upper floor (oak bressummer and joist ends), close-studded gables under a steep 50-degree tiled roof, a tiled hood on curved brackets over the door, a dormer, a brick ridge stack, geranium window boxes. Salle and kitchen, two chambers, two stairs.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
